header: Six kinds of business, one rota problem
lead: The rules and the working week differ by sector. The reasons to stop planning on paper are the same.

cases.title: Retail chains
cases.description: Opening hours that change with the season, and Saturdays that need twice the staff.

cases.title: Hospitality
cases.description: Split shifts, late closing and a rota that changes with the weather forecast.

cases.title: Care homes
cases.description: Qualified staff on every shift, and a night rota with no spare capacity.

cases.title: Facility services
cases.description: Staff spread across client sites, clocking in somewhere different every morning.

cases.title: Logistics depots
cases.description: Peaks announced two weeks ahead, and driving-time rules on top of working-time rules.

cases.title: Garden centres
cases.description: Double staffing for four months of the year and a minimum team for the other eight.
